content: Patients diagnosed with diabetes must be provided with the necessary supplies to effectively manage their condition at home. These essential supplies include blood glucose test strips, which are critical for monitoring blood sugar levels accurately. Additionally, syringes must be made available for the administration of insulin or other injectable medications as prescribed. Lancets, which are used for obtaining blood samples for glucose testing, are also indispensable. Furthermore, any other equipment deemed necessary for comprehensive diabetes management should be supplied to ensure optimal care and control of the disease.
